description: Aspirin inhibits platelet aggregation and can displace warfarin from plasma proteins, significantly increasing bleeding risk.
Potential interaction between ibuprofen and aspirin. Consult a pharmacist.
Potential interaction between metformin and alcohol. Consult a pharmacist.
Potential interaction between warfarin and ibuprofen. Consult a pharmacist.
ACE inhibitors like lisinopril increase potassium retention; adding potassium supplements can cause hyperkalemia.
Potential interaction between simvastatin and amiodarone. Consult a pharmacist.
Omeprazole inhibits CYP2C19, reducing conversion of clopidogrel to its active form and decreasing antiplatelet effect.
Fluoxetine inhibits CYP2D6, increasing tramadol levels. Both lower seizure threshold and risk serotonin syndrome.
Combination increases serotonin syndrome risk and can lower the seizure threshold.
CNS depressant combination can cause profound sedation, respiratory depression, and death.

Potential interaction between warfarin and acetaminophen. Consult a pharmacist.
Combined use can cause severe bradycardia, heart block, or cardiac arrest due to additive negative chronotropic effects.
